member.name: M:Flattener.JsonFlattener.Flatten(System.String,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Flattens a JSON string into a NameValueCollection with dot notation for nested properties. This can handle multiple values per key.
member.param: When true, includes null and empty items in the result.
member.returns: A NameValueCollection containing flattened key-value pairs.

member.name: M:Flattener.XmlFlattener.Flatten(System.String,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Flattens an XML string into a NameValueCollection with dot notation for nested elements. This can handle multiple values per key.
member.param: When true, includes empty elements and null values in the result.
member.returns: A NameValueCollection containing flattened key-value pairs.
